contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with THM-0005 (c(6)=5, so n=6 needs residual geometry) and with the C66-COMP-COMP fibrewise reduced/nonreduced cut. INDEPENDENT DERIVATION. Let C be a smooth proper geometrically connected curve of genus 6 over a field k (Stacks 0BY7: g=dim H^1(O_C) and H^0(O_C)=k, hence χ(O_C)=1-g=-5), D an effective Cartier divisor of degree 4 with h^0(O_C(D))≥2, and L=ω_C(-D). Smooth proper curves are Gorenstein, so Stacks 0C19 gives deg(ω_C)=2g-2=10 and deg L=6. For a geometric point p (so deg(2p)=2), L(-2p) has degree 4. Stacks Lemma 53.5.2 (0BS6) supplies Riemann–Roch χ(E)=deg(E)-(1/2)rk(E)deg(ω) for locally free E on a proper Gorenstein equidimensional curve, hence χ(L(-2p))=4-g+1=-1, together with the dimension symmetry dim H^i(E)=dim H^{1-i}(E^∨⊗ω). Stacks Remark 53.4.3 (0BS4) is the invertible-sheaf form of Serre duality: h^1(L(-2p))=h^0(ω⊗L(2p)^{-1})=h^0(O_C(D+2p)). Therefore h^0(L(-2p))=h^0(O_C(D+2p))-1 identically. The inequality ≥1 is the sheaf inclusion O(D)→O(D+2p) given by a nonzero section of O(2p): on an integral curve this is injective on global sections, so h^0(O(D+2p))≥h^0(O(D))≥2. A nonzero section of L(-2p) produces an effective divisor in the complete system |L| containing 2p, hence nonreduced at p. The same RR also gives h^0(L)=1+h^0(D)≥3, so |L| is nonempty. SCOPE SHARPENING. The displayed equality uses deg(2p)=2 and therefore holds for geometric (or k-rational, k algebraically closed) points, not for a closed point of residue degree d>1, where χ(L(-2p))=1-2d and the identity becomes h^0(L(-2p))=h^0(O(D+2p))+1-2d. Read ‘every point p’ geometrically, which is the campaign’s fibrewise usage. Characteristic is unrestricted: 0BS6/0BS4 have no char-0 hypothesis, and 2p remains a nonreduced length-2 subscheme in every characteristic. The argument does not use balanced CE splitting, base-point-freeness, or constancy of h^0(L)=3. RELATION TO THE CORPUS. Complementary to corroborated FND-0134 (on balanced weakly-normalized fibres with h^0(L)=3, bpf plus char-0 Bertini make a general member reduced, so the reduced-support open is nonempty dense): a nonempty dense open in |L|≅P^2 may be all of P^2, so FND-0134 does not force a nonempty nonreduced complement and does not subsume this lemma. Complementary to FND-0083 (χ(L)=1 does not prove reduced-support nonemptiness). Distinct from FND-0073 (the identity h^0(L)=1+h^0(M)). REV-0140 correctly records that this RR identity repairs ATT-0090’s undocumented 2-jet-kernel input for the nonempty-complement half of (R2); the present finding is that repaired positive lemma, not a defect in the identity. ATT-0090 remains incomplete on other grounds (unbound h^0(L)=3 / WORKING-C66-COMP-COMP), which is FND-0058 territory and is not this lemma. Kind ‘obstruction’ is a mild misclassification: this is a positive residual-series lemma; it obstructs only proposed decompositions that assign an empty nonreduced locus to some |L|. Absence of FND-0136 from the workspace proof/findings.jsonl is the same corpus-registration discrepancy noted for FND-0134; TASK.json is controlling. Merge target: none. Promote candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source. The finding’s sole reviewer_engine (codex) is in this revision’s excluded_engines; this audit is the first non-excluded verification.

scope.exact_mathematical_scope: On a smooth proper geometrically connected genus-6 curve C over a field k, for an effective Cartier divisor D of degree 4 with h^0(O_C(D))≥2 and L=ω_C(-D), every geometric point p satisfies h^0(L(-2p))=h^0(O_C(D+2p))-1≥1, so the complete linear system |L| contains a divisor of multiplicity at least 2 at p.
excluded_claims: Does not prove that a general member of |L| is reduced or that the reduced-support open is nonempty or dense (FND-0134).
Does not prove h^0(L)=3 on every balanced fibre, nor that the hyperelliptic/h^0=4 branch is empty on the balanced locus (FND-0058/FND-0104).
The displayed equality is false as written for a closed point of residue degree d>1.
Does not compute the dimension or class of the nonreduced locus in |L|.
Does not by itself complete ATT-0090.
